_label: MEASURED -- real Verilator RTL-vs-RTL cosimulation, not estimated
operation_under_test: 1.0f / d (Q4_0's id = 1/d), plus general-purpose a/b coverage

toolchain.verilator: tools/.local-verilator (same version used by Phase A/B1)

latency_cycles.note: min=3 is the EARLY_OUT_SPECIAL path (NaN/Inf/zero operands, no iteration needed); max=29 (no-backpressure) is the full general-path iterative-division latency (26 restoring-division cycles + 1 issue cycle + 1 round cycle + 1 retire-wait cycle, OUT_REG_DEPTH=0); backpressure-affected cases extend measured latency up to 48 cycles purely from held-low out_ready, not from extra computation.

initiation_interval.measured_via: 2000 back-to-back general-path transactions (58000 cycles / 2000 txn), no backpressure
initiation_interval.note: single in-flight design point: II == general-path latency, by construction (task spec explicitly does not target II=1 for this first variant)

decision_input: 0 mismatches across 2,456,685 cases (including full specials x specials cross product, exhaustive denominator exponent/mantissa boundary sweep, real q4 runtime d-distribution, and 2.2M+ uniform random cases) -- exact bit-for-bit parity achieved against membrane_fp_divider.sv for the 1.0f/d operation. Integration into q4_scale (Phase B2 Q4 path) is authorized by this result per the task's own gating rule.
